nodes.action: Translate requirements into a compact verification matrix covering healthy behavior, malformed inputs, failure paths, concurrency or adversarial timing, and non-functional constraints.
nodes.name: Define acceptance oracle
preconditions: The task description specifies observable behavior and constraints
nodes.validator: Every stated requirement maps to at least one observable check, including at least one failure-mode check.

nodes.action: Trace the existing control flow and state ownership, using logs and tests to identify where inputs, shared state, errors, and output shaping are handled.
nodes.name: Inspect implementation evidence
preconditions: The target workspace is readable
nodes.validator: The suspected path is grounded in source evidence and covers all components named by the acceptance oracle.

nodes.action: Execute focused baseline probes that isolate the reported trigger, compare them with normal cases, and record status, payload, diagnostics, timing, and repeatability.
nodes.name: Reproduce the defect
preconditions: A runnable service, job, or focused test path exists
nodes.validator: The defect is reproduced or a source-level proof explains it; normal behavior is separately observed.

nodes.action: Follow the failing value or state transition to its ownership boundary, distinguish the causal defect from downstream symptoms, and formulate a minimal invariant-restoring change.
nodes.name: Localize the root cause
preconditions: Evidence from inspection and reproduction is available
nodes.validator: The root-cause statement explains the trigger, the observed symptom, and why unaffected cases currently pass.

nodes.action: Edit the existing implementation at the responsible boundary, preserving public shapes and normal semantics while making shared state, validation, failure propagation, or timing behavior safe for the trigger.
nodes.name: Implement the minimal invariant fix
preconditions: A root cause and patch strategy have been established
nodes.validator: The change is confined to the requested workspace, does not replace the project with a stub, and does not hide errors or impose unnecessary serialization.

nodes.action: Run normal, invalid, repeated, concurrent, timeout, partial-failure, authorization, or equivalent stress cases selected by the matrix; inspect both returned artifacts and diagnostics.
nodes.name: Run adversarial verification
preconditions: The implementation has been edited
nodes.validator: All required contract checks pass, the original trigger no longer fails, failures remain explicit, and diagnostics contain no protected or misleading data.

nodes.action: Review the final diff for accidental behavior changes, unsafe broad exception handling, data leakage, stale state, missing output paths, and avoidable latency regressions.
nodes.name: Check regression and diff integrity
preconditions: Adversarial verification has completed
nodes.validator: The diff is minimal and coherent; every changed behavior is justified by the requirements or the root-cause fix.

nodes.action: Report the root cause, applied fix, verification coverage, and any bounded residual risk without reproducing private reasoning or unrelated artifacts.
nodes.name: Finalize evidence-backed handoff
preconditions: Regression assessment is clean or residual risks are documented
nodes.validator: The handoff identifies edited artifacts and states whether the acceptance oracle passed.

nodes.action: Inspect and exercise error-handling paths to ensure caught failures retain their intended explicit response semantics, status signaling, and termination behavior without falling through or being silently transformed.
nodes.name: Preserve explicit failure responses
preconditions: The implementation has been edited
nodes.validator: Relevant failure paths produce explicit, stable rejection behavior and do not continue into unrelated success or fallthrough handling.
